summary: Applies CEQA, notwithstanding any other law, to the issuance of entitlements related to the development and operation of a data center, and bars categorical exemptions for data center projects (with carve-outs for public, utility, telecom and university research facilities). Adds data centers meeting eleven conditions, including 4-hour zero-carbon storage at 100% of forecasted peak and 100% zero-carbon hourly supply within five years (75% new), to the environmental leadership fast track.

source.citation: SB 887, Chapter 439, Statutes of 2026 (chaptered text, LegiScan mirror)

notes: CORRECTION: status proposed -> adopted. CORRECTION: previous summary said it bars "blanket" CEQA exemptions, understating 21080.08. No size threshold: data center defined by function. Whether 21080.08 reaches otherwise ministerial approvals is a legal question not resolved here.
confidence_note: Read in the chaptered text reproduced by LegiScan. Interpretation of 21080.08 scope not asserted.
text: Notwithstanding any other law, this division shall apply to the issuance of entitlements related to the development and operation of a data center.
